notes: Generic sub-application dispatcher for overlay 01. ov01_02206C60 is a 9-row jump table {init, main, exit, overlayId} selected by per-task index; ov01_021F69C0 is the SysTask state machine driving load->fade-in->init->main->exit->fade-out with overlay (un)loading. Two accessor families: '021F6Bxx' operate on Manager->_d8 dispatcher/child task; '021F6Cxx' operate on a TaskManager whose _30 points to a Manager. ov01_021F6BB0 (sprite whitelist) and ov01_021F6BD0 (script-id ranges) are standalone predicates called from overlay_27.s field-interaction code. Entry-callback triples wired from tables in overlay_01_021EAF00.s. No src/ callers; all callers asm. No .data/.bss and no DECL_CHUNK_EX / save_arrays involvement.
